provider: pcloud / koofr / icedrive / proton drive / mediafire / degoo

free_tier.stated: pCloud: up to 10 GB of free storage. Koofr Free: 10 GB, free forever, 50 GB daily public transfer limit. Icedrive free account: 10 GB. Proton Drive Free: 5 GB. MediaFire Basic: 10 GB with ad-supported downloads. Degoo Free: 20 GB cloud space with a 90-day account inactivity limit
free_tier.notes: pCloud and Proton Drive state that no credit card is required for the free plan; Koofr's free plan is stated as free forever

identity_cost.detail: Email address is the sign-up credential: the Koofr create-account form asks for an email address, Icedrive sends a confirmation code to the email address, and Degoo requests a username, password and email address. Card: pCloud and Proton Drive state none. Phone: Proton may ask for a code by SMS or to a secondary email address as an alternative to a CAPTCHA. The sign-up forms of pCloud and MediaFire were not readable: unverified.

reliability_note: Degoo Free lists a 90 days account inactivity limit; the reliability of the other five providers is unverified.
